title: nf-WGS-QC pipeline parameters for reports generation
description: Whole genome sequencing quality control pipeline.

output_options.title: Output options
output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

reference_files.title: Reference files
reference_files.description: Input reference files shared by all workflows

genome_fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file. A fasta index (.fai) must be present in the same location

report_generation_inputs.title: Report generation inputs
report_generation_inputs.description: Input files required for report generation

alignment_qc_inputs.description: A file listing alignment QC folders to collect. These are expected to contain outputs from the ALIGNEMENT QC workflow

variant_qc_inputs.description: A file listing variant QC folders to collect. These are expected to contain outputs from the VARIANT QC workflow

project_qc_inputs.description: A file listing project QC folders to collect. Pipeline will collect output from alignment_qc and variant_qc subfolders

alignment_qc_criteria.description: A YML file describing alignment QC FAIL/WARN criteria

variant_qc_criteria.description: A YML file describing variant QC FAIL/WARN criteria

ped_file.description: A standard PED file describing relationship between samples. If omitted all samples are treated as unrelated

somalier_labels.description: Path to file describing sample labels for the somalier ancestry reference samples

somalier_1kgdata.description: Path to a folder containing somalier files for the ancestry reference samples

report_generation_configuration.title: Report generation configuration
report_generation_configuration.description: Configure the execution of report generation

make_reports.description: Run the QC report workflow to generate QC reports summarizing samples PASS/FAIL status
